title: Face2Face Failure Characterization & Candidate Mechanism Analysis

preregistered_hypotheses_for_m15.title: 3DMM Reenactment Within-Manifold Confinement
preregistered_hypotheses_for_m15.observation: Missed Face2Face queries exhibit high-frequency Laplacian variance (0.1756) indistinguishable from pristine clean reals (0.1430). Because 3DMM expression transfer re-renders facial mesh parameters without boundary splices, spatial frequency residuals fail to trigger.
preregistered_hypotheses_for_m15.m15_preregistered_test: Evaluate whether high-resolution landmark deformation vectors or dense optical flow fields provide a separable representation on a newly partitioned training split, without using M14 test queries.

preregistered_hypotheses_for_m15.title: Multi-Domain Fusion Head Gating Suppression
preregistered_hypotheses_for_m15.observation: In 0.0% of missed Face2Face queries, the auxiliary competition head flagged an anomaly (p_aux_fake >= 0.50, mean=0.004), but the multi-domain fusion head heavily suppressed the primary score (p_fused=0.002) because the temporal trunk predicted authentic.
preregistered_hypotheses_for_m15.m15_preregistered_test: Evaluate an attention-gated dynamic fusion architecture where branch weights are conditioned on cross-attention between spatial and temporal representations, preventing unconditional dominance by the temporal trunk.

preregistered_hypotheses_for_m15.title: Uniform Frame Pooling Temporal Smoothing
preregistered_hypotheses_for_m15.observation: Face2Face reenactments introduce subtle asynchronous expression transitions (mouth phoneme lag, unnatural eyebrow blinks) that occur over 2-3 frame windows. The global temporal transformer with uniform 16-frame self-attention smooths these localized phase anomalies.
preregistered_hypotheses_for_m15.m15_preregistered_test: Investigate temporal multi-scale windowed attention (e.g. hierarchical short-window + long-window transformer) to isolate short-duration expression phase mismatches.

non_modification_attestation: No M13.5 weights, calibration parameters, or thresholds were modified. No M15 parameter was selected.
